_comment: Voices at decisions (scripts/voices.gd). Before you choose, up to max of your officers and the hands you know (those with a want) speak for or against a choice, from their traits. Each choice has stances: cruel (blood and fear; below 0 mercy), decent (honour, a word kept; below 0 a dirty trick), greedy (money in; below 0 money out), bold (a fight; below 0 backing off). Event choices get them from their outcomes (infer: verb -> stance per point of its number, or 'kill'/'fight' flat) unless they say "voice": {stance: n} (or {} to stay quiet). traits: how much each trait cares about each stance. A person speaks if their score for some choice reaches min; heeded: opinion when you take the choice they spoke for (or pass over the one they spoke against); overruled: when you don't.

for: They'd do the same to us, given half a chance.
Fear's cheaper than powder, Captain.
Make an example. The next lot will remember.
against: We're not butchers, Captain.
God sees what we do out here, even this far from land.
Do that and we're no better than the ones they hang.

for: Let them be. It costs us nothing.
Mercy now buys us something later.
There's been enough blood.
against: Mercy's for men who can afford it.
Soft hearts get cut throats.
They'll laugh at us in every tavern from here to Tortuga.

for: It's the right thing, Captain, and you know it.
A name's worth more than a purse out here.
Do it straight, and sleep easy.
against: Decency doesn't fill the hold.
Honour's a fine thing for men with pensions.
Nobody out here will thank you for it.

for: Nobody'll ever know.
Everyone does it. The clever ones just don't get caught.
A word given to them isn't worth the breath.
against: A word's a word, Captain. Break it, and who'll trust us?
That's a dirty trick, and it'll come back on us.
I didn't sign on for this.

for: Think of the money.
Shares all round, Captain.
Money is money.
against: Some money costs more than it pays.
That gold's got a curse on it.
We're not that hungry.

for: Money's for spending, and this is worth it.
Pay it and be done.
Cheap at the price.
against: That's our shares you're throwing away.
Not one coin, Captain.
We bled for that money.

for: We can take them.
Let's have at it!
I didn't come to sea to run.
against: That's a fool's fight, Captain.
Dead men spend no shares.
Count their guns before you count the prize.

for: Live to fight another day.
No shame in a wise course.
Not this one, Captain. Not today.
against: Running? The crew will never let us forget it.
We look like cowards.
They'll think we're soft.
